translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nzkotq-krbz Pol Mz Gavzna Festzs
Zbq tq otx mz nibr Festzs nzkaputr-krmle mz provins kc mz nzngini-krde gavzna, rkalzm Sisaria, sc tqvzdzpe Jerusalem.
X kxnzetu rdr pris x lrtzlvz ngr lr Jiu nzpipxlr nzvz-rbrkr Pol. X nzrlxti-kzpzlr mz Festzs kx
na-aelwa-ngrbzle badr nzrmrlztingr, mz nzatwzlr-krmle Pol mz nzkotq-krde Jerusalem. A' nzrpilr da lc murde nzryrlq-kapqng drtwr kx nanibqlr Pol mz lrpzki.
Rpibz Festzs kx, “Pol nzamnc mz presin kc mz taon Sisaria. X mzli trnaboiu sa nayzlu-moux elr.
Kxnzrmailz rmung navzokr badr. X napipxlr nzvz-rbr-krdeng elr.”
Festzs mnctilr badr wiki esz', x sc tqvzope Sisaria. Nrlc ngrlxobz sc tqvztrpe mz nabz mangr-nzkotqngr, x sc tqrkape natq kx ncblo ngr vea nedeng navzmitrplr Pol.
Mzli kc Pol tqkaputr-ngrbzle, lr Jiu kcng nztu-ngalelvzlr nide, x sc tzrping brmrda ngr natq kx vz-rbrti Pol kx trpnzngr me nztukitrlr.
A' Pol aclve-lzbq mz nzrpi-krbzle kx, “Trpnzngr da kx alex kx vz-rbrtr mz lou sc lr Jiu, o mz Mangr-nzangiongr, o mz king kc etu kc Rom.”
Kxmule-esz', a' Gavzna Festzs rpile namrlzba lr Jiu kcng, murde ma tzota-zvzng. X sc tqveapebz mz Pol tqrpipebzle kx, “?Mrlz nzvzdz-krm Jerusalem, x na-abzpxm mz da lcng elr?”
Rpibz Pol kx, “Tqtutrpo mz kot nyz king kxetu x takitrde nzpipx-krbzme kx vz-rbrx o trtingr mz kot ka. Trpnzngr da kx vz-rbr kx alebo mz lr Jiu, da kc tqwai nzkrlz-zpwx-krmle.

A' nzmu kx tqvz-rbrpex mz lou sc lr Rom, x alepex dq da kx nanibq-ngrnge, e tr-rlxtiwxu nzplcsz-krngele. A' nzmu kx trpnzngr da kx ngi da angidr mz natq lcng tzpiti-ngrdr ninge, e mz nzvz-nqblq-krde lou ngr Rom, trpnzngr kx nakaobzle ninge badr. Mzli ka rlxtibo atwzlr-ngrbz ninge mz king kc Rom mz nzkotq-krnge elr.”
Festzs nzryapwxtxng badr ncblo kx nzatubqtilr nide. Zbz sc tqrpipebzle kx, “Rlxtiq nzkotqtr-krbzme mz mz king kc Rom, e sa na-atwzlrpe-ngrbzkr nim bade.”
Festzs Pibzle Pol Mz King Herot Agripz
Kzdung mzli mz nibrde, King Herot Agripz Krali kc tqaclvele Provins kc Gzlili x inwede Bernis nzvzmqng mz taon Sisaria, mz nzoklati-krmlr Festzs murde sc tqngini-atede gavzna.
Mz nibr nzmncti-krdr mrkc kzdung zbq, Festzs kc tqaopxpebzle mz king nrpa ngr Pol. Rpibzle kx, “Kzdq kc ncblo mrka kx amnctx Gavzna Filiks mz presin sc tqrlaszpele.
X kx vzdzx kc Jerusalem, lrtzlvzng x kxnzetu rdr pris r lr Jiu sc tzrlxtipemlr bange kx napix kx mrlx lc vz-rbr.
“A' rpibo badr kx lou sc lr Rom tr-rlrpx-ngrdeu nzaprcngr ncblo mz nzbz-krde, a' narmcti-lzbq-kaing badr leplz kcng tzrpilr kx vz-rbr mz kot. Murde napipxle mz kot trnzvz-rbr-krdeu.
Kx nzvzmlr mrka, sc trpnz-moungr da kx na-aenzlix, a' mz nrlc kxngrlxobz sc tqwxbuope-ngrne mrkc tzrpipxngr nztubqkr doa o trtingr, x sc tqrpipebo kx ncblo kc navzmitrp.
A' nzvz-rbr-krdeng kcng tzpipxlr, trngi-pnzu da kc tqpnz drtwrnge kx napipxlr.
Murde nzpipxlr kx nzvz-rbrkr Pol tutr mz kzdung da mz nzrlxngiti-krdr, x mz kzdq ncblo drtqde Jiszs, bzpe, a' Pol rpile sa tqlu.
Trkrlzwxu kxnamusr-ngrne trnzesz'ti-kru lc drtwr. Mz drtwr lc, veatibo mz Pol nzmu kx tqmrlzbz bade nzvzdz-krde Jerusalem mz nzabzpx-krngele mz da lcng elr.
A' pxtxpx-ngrde. Rlxtile kx na-aclvepwz nide, navz nakrlzbzle mzli kc na-atwzlr-ngrbo nide mz king kc etu kc Rom, mz nzkotq-krde elr.”
Rpibz Agripz mz Festzs kx, “Suti drtwrnge nzxlrngr nzycmnekr ncblo lc mz ninge esz'-krnge.” Rpibz Festzs kx, “Xlr-krlzq kalrla.”
King Agripz Lalztqbz Mz Nzycmnekr Pol

Nrlc ngrlxobz leplz kcng tzglqlzlr Agripz ncdr Bernis mz nzngini-krdr kxnzetung mzli kc tzvz-ngrmlr mrkc tzyrlwr-lxblrngr. Nzdwatrpzng mz nabz kzdq ma nyz gzpman, mrkc kxnzetung tzlalztq-ngrbzlr mz leplz nedrng. X kxnzetu r ami kcng x kxnzrmailzng lr taon kc nzdwatr-kzpzng. Festzs rkatxbz natq, x Pol kc tzvzmitrpem.
Zbz Festzs kc tqrpipebzle kx, “King Agripz, x nimu lcng amrlx tqmnckr badr mrka, pwxbztiamu ncblo lc! Lr Jiu amrlx mrkc Jerusalem x mrka Sisaria, nzrtwzmqng natq bange, x nznemilr kx nanibq.
A' trmcwxu kzdq da kx alele kx nanibq-ngrde. X pnzpe drtwrnge nzatwzlr-krngele Rom, murde rlxtile nzkotqtr-krbzle mz mz king kc etu.

Trkrlzkax da kx nayrx mz letz kx nayrbo mz king, mz nzpi-krbo Pol. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, vzmipemc nide bamu mrka, x myapxbz nim, kx King Agripz! Murde mz nibr nzvea-krbzmu da bade, mwx elx sc tqngiscpenge dq da kx nayrx.
Murde trtakitrdeu nzatwzlr-krbo ncblo mz King, mz trnzayrbq-zpwx-ngru mz nzryrngr da kznikeng nzrpilr kx vz-rbr-ngrde.”

footnotes.text: King Niro nide king r Rom mz yiz lcng. Doa kx gzpman ngr Rom rlr-ngrbzle nzprtr-krde mz dzbede kc tqmyapxbz nzrngiscng zmatq ngr nzrlxtingr nzkotq-ngrbz mz king kxetu Rom. Trpnzngr kx krlzle nzrpwa'-ngrbz da lc.

King Agripz krlz-zpwxle lou sc lr Jiu, kxmule-esz' trprtru mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nqmq krdr. King Niro nangyati drtwrde Festzs nzmu na-atwzlr-ngrbzle Pol bade, a' trpnzngr nou rde kxtubq. Murde nzwzkr kxnzetung mz provins nzatubqti-krdr dalr provins nyzdrng nidr esz'-krdr x bzkq nzayakukulr King Niro.
